definitions.gloss: to bet, to wager, to gamble
definitions.explanation: To risk money or something valuable on the outcome of an uncertain event.

examples.japanese: {父|ちち}は{毎週|まいしゅう}{競馬|けいば}に{賭|か}けている。
examples.english: My father bets on horse racing every week.

examples.japanese: {命|いのち}を{賭|か}けて{戦|たたか}う。
examples.notes: Figurative use: to stake one's life.

examples.japanese: {勝負|しょうぶ}に{金|かね}を{賭|か}けた。
examples.english: I bet money on the match.

notes:
{賭|か}ける means to bet or wager on something.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜に{賭|か}ける: to bet on (something)
- 〜を{賭|か}ける: to stake (something)
- {命|いのち}を{賭|か}ける: to risk one's life
- {名誉|めいよ}を{賭|か}ける: to stake one's honor

RELATED WORDS:
- {賭|か}け: bet, wager (noun)
- {賭博|とばく}: gambling
- {賭|か}け{事|ごと}: gambling

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: Transitive ({他動詞|たどうし})
- Pattern: 〜を〜に{賭|か}ける

NOTE:
This is a different word from かける (00854_kakeru) which means "to hang" or "to make a call."
